//: canopy K1b: modules that several component scripts used to inline, shipped once (scripts/client/shared-modules.mjs).
modules: module -> its provider, the first js/component-scripts.json script that uses it. The provider publishes the
module's namespace on JE.core.sharedModules before its own code runs; every later script that imports the module
gets a stub reading that copy instead of inlining it. The build fails if a consumer loads before the provider.
Only stateless modules belong here: the build checks the module's whole runtime import closure for top-level state
(let/var, classes, collections, calls, top-level statements). A binding it cannot clear syntactically needs a
reviewed entry saying why it holds no state. Left duplicated on purpose (stateful): see
host-discovery and everything importing them, e.g. seerr/core/runtime.ts).

client/src/features/seerr/core/decode.ts.reason: SeerrDecodeError has no static members and is only ever thrown (`throw new`); nothing in client/src tests `instanceof SeerrDecodeError`, so one shared class is indistinguishable from per-script copies. The *Checks tables are module-private, built once at load from the pure combinators optional/nullable/listOf/either (each returns a closure over its arguments only) and only read by matches() through Object.entries.

client/src/features/media-tags/layout/la.reason: Constant tables. GROUPS is a Set no client source references after its declaration (JE.core.tagLayout.GROUPS is a DEFAULT_ORDER.slice() copy). The other four are object literals given a null prototype once at load by withoutPrototype() and then only read (hasOwn, indexing, includes, Object.values, spread copies); no client source assigns to, deletes from or mutates them.
